settings.title: Accessibility
settings.body:
Maison des Nus is committed to making our website accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

Our commitment

We work toward WCAG 2.1 AA conformance across the site. We support screen readers, full keyboard navigation, high color contrast, and resizable text.

Need help?

If you have trouble accessing any part of this site, please email access@maisondesnus.com.
